integrity: Includes a self-contained symbolic block argument and a standalone direct-graph checker; finite computations are corroboration rather than infinite certification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to ordinary squared cycles with at least seven vertices, and to one-token exchanges among maximum sets only. An independent audit is not performed. Published complexity results and maximum-independent-set results do not establish the dissociation exchange classification. Inaccessible/unindexed equivalences remain a residual risk.
title: Four-periodic optimal dissociation exchanges in squared cycles
